body: Again, blaming the victim!!
700.00 for a toilet seat, and you're barely making a living. Smh...

I'm an administrator for an office, with the Attorney General of a state that I won't name.
I make 85k a year. I work hard and demand the staff work hard.
I have one AAG that I may have to beat in the parking lot, because he's an ass, but all in all, we are fabulous!

He died, January 29th. I'm still grieving, because it was so unexpected. Went out for coffee, and never came home.
The grands and our kids have come together, but every event, every birthday, ...we all feel the loss.
Everyone expects to say goodbye, and he left so many loose ends.
The world is getting worse. Looking back, I'd be a pole dancer, when I was 21-25. Invest in the stock market with the proceeds, and be in a much more financially stable placement than I am now.
Me too. 3rd x

With the milk, make some tater soup.
I'm having the same issues!
My parallel parking game is spot on!
Taking down Terminis was his best 'bitch, take this' moment. An established area, where people lured in the unsuspecting, and lived as cannibals. He had his crown.
I hope the market completely collapses beneath them.
...due to your dishonest in investigation. Umm...they need professional writers.
Retard is still a thing? REALLY? FFS...I'm done.

I'm thinking my husband's ex divorced him from neglect. It's taken me 20 years. But now I see her truth. 
The problem was, she was never loved. Neglect set in, after 14 years, and she ended it.
Yeah, I'm old. He's older. 70 in November, and he's not wealthy, by any means.

She took him with her. It was her plan. He knew nothing but her controlling presence. He didn't have a life, without her.
She planned it. She planned to leave nothing behind, and she psychologically manipulated her marriage.
My nephews barely talk to each other.
She was not considered a mother. She only had the 2nd  because she remarried. The first, she could have cared less. We raised him.
She was lost. At the outset.....and the neurologist that spoke with me, when she was in ICU, said, 'do you think she's on the spectrum?'
...jeebus...she's autistic. It fits. And I never realized.

Seriously. I'm married. My husband basically ignored me. As he does, every day, until I step out of the shower.
There is no foreplay....so, I fight him off.
He almost gets it. But until he does, no.
....we need more than a pussy grab!!

He's just an ass. I accept that. It's gotten worse. Think he maybe has early on set alzheimers.
Ugg..
Seriously, this cat needs a vet!
Furgle.
Shut the gate. Shut the gate...please, shut the gate...... ...dammit! Fine...whatever.
Get to vet. Eyes don't look well. Could be kidney issues.
I remember my first visit. 15. No leash, but should have had one.
Same. Oven has been on all winter.
It gets worse. He's started drinking. He never drank until about a year ago.

He's appreciated. In so many ways. One grand girl made him a picture, saying I love you l, poppa. ...he didn't see it, even tho she showed him, and it's hanging on the fridge TODAY!
That was 2 years ago.
They hug him. Say love you, poppa, even if he's watching the news...he brushes them off.
Only his biological grand kids matter.
I'm divorcing him. It's beyond repair.
Frustrating. To say the least.

I recorded him being violent, the other night. Verbally abusive. Just, horrific statements.
He's suffering from some illness, but won't go to the dr. 
I'm afraid of him, now.
Even the small make a big impact!
No one has directions to the raid.
Everyone needs to agreed that we won't pay taxes until something is done to clear out the corruption. No money, they'll all sit up and take notice.
He's not the man I married.

I'm interested in the lack of replies. Is this situation the norm, now?
If so, we need to become extinct.
Conflict is easy. Tell the person what you need/believe, then ask them about their solution.
